Engineering

Control Motor Principal

The central console or system used to monitor and operate the ship’s main propulsion engine, including remote start, stop, RPM, alarms, and critical parameter displays, typically located in the engine control room or bridge.

Questions and answers

Questions and answers

What is Control Motor Principal?

In this glossary, Control Motor Principal refers to: The central console or system used to monitor and operate the ship’s main propulsion engine, including remote start, stop, RPM, alarms, and critical parameter displays, typically located in the engine control room or bridge.

How is Control Motor Principal used in maritime?

In maritime communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Puente a sala de máquinas, confirme que el control del motor principal está en remoto para la salida. Prepárese para aumentar las RPM a mi orden."

Why does Control Motor Principal matter in maritime?

Control Motor Principal matters because it supports clear communication in Engineering contexts for Deck Officers, Engine Officers, and Masters. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as STCW, Marlins Test, ISF Watchkeeper, and GMDSS.

Who uses Control Motor Principal?

Control Motor Principal is mainly used by Deck Officers, Engine Officers, and Masters.

What category does Control Motor Principal belong to?

Definition

Bridge to engine room, please confirm main engine control is set to remote for departure. Stand by to increase RPM on my command.
